scope: convex/**/*.ts (excluding _generated/, *.d.ts, *.test.ts) + explicit convex/http.ts scope; 3-pass audit (Security / Performance / Code Quality)
pilot_mode: READ-ONLY (no edits, no commits, no pushes, no PRs)

pass_summaries.security: Tightened through Clerk auth on most user-facing endpoints, internal-only convention on most cron/trigger callbacks, and lib/serviceAuth.ts:assertServiceKey for server-only mutations. Substantial number of public query/mutation exports leak PII or accept mutations from any signed-in (or unauthenticated) caller. Critical clusters: queries/http.ts, mutations/http.ts, payments.ts, users.ts, studentOnboarding.ts, discordActionQueue.ts, userIdentities.ts, videoEditorAssignments.ts, studentSessionCounts.ts, adminWorkspaces.ts. The confirmSeed: true enumerable guard on linkWorkspaceToSessionPack is intentional per its docstring but is still a public surface any Convex client can hit.
pass_summaries.performance: Many queries rely on .filter() after withIndex (migrateOrder at orders.ts:366; monthlyStorageCosts.ts:73; payments.ts:66; cleanup.ts:24; multiple branches in workspaces.ts note pagination). Date.now() appears in query handlers (queries/http.ts:12,26; monthlyStorageCosts.ts:30). The 30k document scan cap in queries/emailHealth.ts and full-collect runners in migrations.ts are documented and intentional.
pass_summaries.code_quality: Spec violations cluster around Convex export-kind labels: resolveUploadAccess/resolveDownloadAccess are public query despite 'Internal query' docstrings (onboardingWorkExamples.ts:231,653); getNotificationForRecipient is internalMutation though it only reads (recordingReadyNotifications.ts:222). Several handlers take args with no returns validator. studentOnboarding.ts:378 getSignedUrlsByStorageIds is publicly exposed despite its own docstring calling it 'intended for trusted internal callers'.

http_router_audit.verdict: PASS — every registered HTTP route uses verifyAuth (CONVEX_HTTP_KEY, refuse when env var missing in prod) or verifyCallbackSecret (two-key); Clerk and Resend webhook routes additionally use Svix signature verification. Dev-mode credential-bypass helpers only apply when NODE_ENV !== 'production' and are scoped to tests. No unauthenticated public HTTP route discovered. However, helpers in convex/queries/http.ts and convex/mutations/http.ts ARE exposed as public Convex queries/mutations (only gated at the HTTP-key layer when invoked through the HTTP router). A direct Convex client bypasses them.

findings.issue: getUserByEmail is a public query that, after an auth check that returns null, lets ANY signed-in Convex client fetch a complete user record by email (PII dump including role, clerkId, firstName, lastName, timeZone).
findings.fix: Restrict to caller-self OR admin; or move to internalQuery and call from a server-only HTTP endpoint gated by CONVEX_HTTP_KEY.

findings.issue: getUserById is a public query that lets any signed-in caller fetch any user record by document id (IDOR; full row including role, clerkId, email).
findings.fix: Restrict to admin/support or caller-self; move public variants to internalQuery.

findings.issue: getUsersByUserIds is a public query that lets any signed-in client bulk-fetch user rows by an arbitrary array of userId strings (PII + role dump).
findings.fix: Restrict to admin/support; or only return rows owned by the caller.

findings.issue: getUsersByClerkIds has NO auth check at all — even an unauthenticated Convex client can fetch user rows by an arbitrary list of Clerk IDs (PII leak before sign-in).
findings.fix: Add getUserIdentity() gate (return [] when none), restrict to admin/support, or move to internalQuery.

findings.issue: listUsers is a public query and returns a paginated stream of the entire users table to any signed-in caller — full PII dump.
findings.fix: Restrict to admin role; or move to internalQuery.

findings.issue: getUsersByRole lets any signed-in client enumerate every user with the requested role (admin/instructor/student) — PII + role dump.
findings.fix: Restrict to admin.

findings.issue: getActiveUsersByRole — same shape as getUsersByRole, plus full instructor-profile resolution; allows any signed-in caller to enumerate all active instructor profiles.
findings.fix: Restrict to admin.

findings.issue: createUser is a public mutation with NO auth check; ANY caller can insert a new users row with an arbitrary role (admin, instructor, etc.). Privilege escalation by account creation.
findings.fix: Restrict to admin/support, gate via assertServiceKey, or convert to internalMutation and call from a server-only HTTP route.

findings.issue: migrateUser is a public mutation with NO auth check; lets any caller insert OR update users rows with an arbitrary role, including admin. Account-takeover / privilege-escalation vector.
findings.fix: Gate via assertServiceKey or convert to internalMutation.

findings.issue: getAllUsersForMigration is a public query with NO auth check; returns the entire users table (PII dump, including clerkId, role).
findings.fix: Move to internalQuery (clearly a migration helper) or admin-gate.

findings.issue: getAllInstructors is a public query with NO auth check; returns name+email+userId for every user with role=instructor. PII leak of every instructor.
findings.fix: Admin-gate or restrict to callers with a workspace-relationship to an instructor.

findings.issue: getAdminStats is a public query with NO auth check; lets any caller pull admin-only dashboard counts.
findings.fix: Admin-gate.

findings.issue: getPaymentById is a public query that returns the full payment row (orderId, provider, providerPaymentId, amount, status, refundedAmount) to ANY signed-in caller by ID. IDOR; payment data exposure.
findings.fix: Restrict to caller-as-owner or admin; or move to internalQuery and call from the refund action that already admin-gates.

findings.issue: getOrderPayments returns every payment tied to a given orderId to any signed-in caller (IDOR by orderId).
findings.fix: Restrict to caller-as-order-owner or admin.

findings.issue: getPaymentByProviderId lets any signed-in caller look up a payment by (provider, providerPaymentId) — provider payment IDs are discoverable via receipt URLs and Order IDs; exposes amount/status/refundedAmount. IDOR.
findings.fix: Restrict to caller-as-order-owner or admin.

findings.issue: getCompletedPaymentByOrderAndProvider — same IDOR against (orderId, provider) for any signed-in caller. Filters with .filter() after withIndex (compounds the perf nit).
findings.fix: Restrict to order-owner or admin; rewrite the filter as part of the index.

findings.issue: createPayment is public mutation with NO auth; ANY caller can mint a payment row with arbitrary fields. status defaults to args.status ?? 'pending' — caller can pass completed/refunded/etc.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey(args.serviceKey) and require an order the caller owns; or move to internalMutation.

findings.issue: updatePayment is public mutation with NO auth; any caller can patch any payment's status to pending/completed/refunded/failed AND patch refundedAmount.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey or internal-only.

findings.issue: completePayment is public mutation with NO auth; any caller can mark any payment 'completed' — direct revenue-fraud vector since refunds depend on completed payments.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey or internal-only (called from verified Stripe/PayPal webhook handlers).

findings.issue: refundPayment is public mutation with NO auth; any caller can mark any payment 'refunded' AND set an arbitrary refundedAmount.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey or internal-only.

findings.issue: failPayment is public mutation with NO auth; any caller can mark any payment 'failed'.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey or internal-only.

findings.issue: adminProcessRefund checks identity only, NOT role. The file's own comment (lines 156-160) notes the bug and points to adminProcessRefundInternal as the fix; the public mutation should not exist.
findings.fix: Delete the public adminProcessRefund; keep only adminProcessRefundInternal (admin-gated + idempotency-safe) and expose a service-keyed or admin-gated HTTP path.

findings.issue: deletePayment is public mutation with NO auth; soft-deletes any payment by id.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey or internal-only.

findings.issue: migratePayment is public mutation with NO auth; lets any caller insert or update payments rows with provider-payment-IDs of their choice, including status='completed'.
findings.fix: Gate on assertServiceKey (matches migrateOrder pattern) or convert to internalMutation.

findings.issue: getWorkspacesNeedingDeletion is a public query with no auth or service-key check; returns a list of every workspace approaching 18-month retention (ownerId, instructorId, endedAt).

findings.issue: getWorkspacesForNotification is a public query with no auth or service-key check; returns owner+instructor+daysUntilDeletion for every workspace in the 90/30/7-day retention window.

findings.issue: getUserEmail is a public query; lets any signed-in Convex client fetch any user's email by clerkId. PII lookup. Docstring explicitly says 'server-only' but it's exported as public.

findings.issue: getUserIdByEmail is a public query; any signed-in Convex client can resolve a user _id by email — PII/email-to-id enumeration.

findings.issue: getWorkspaceExportData is a public query; any signed-in Convex client can read any workspace's notes + image URLs/b2Keys by ID. Note contents are private mentorship content — IDOR + content leak.

findings.issue: getWorkspaceExport is a public query; any signed-in Convex client can fetch export status + workspaceId + ownerId for any export ID.

findings.issue: createRetentionNotification is public mutation with no auth or service-key check; any signed-in Convex client can mint retention notifications against arbitrary user/workspace pairs. Notification-spam vector.
findings.fix: Move to internalMutation (called from the HTTP route after verifyAuth).

findings.issue: updateWorkspaceExportStatus is public mutation with no auth or service-key check; any signed-in Convex client can patch any export's status. Per-row guards refuse 'completed → anything' and 'failed w/o errorMessage → anything', but an attacker can still set a pending export to 'completed' pre-emptively, creating phony export-completion emails.
findings.fix: Move to internalMutation (called from the HTTP route after verifyAuth + export-request ownership check).

findings.issue: migrateUserIdentity is public mutation with NO auth; lets any caller write Discord user IDs onto any user's record. Account-linking abuse.

findings.issue: linkWorkspaceToSessionPack is a public mutation whose ONLY guard is the typed literal confirmSeed:true. findings.issue: markReviewed is public mutation with NO auth; only checks sub.instructorId === args.instructorId against the submitted args. Any caller can mark ANY submission reviewed by passing an arbitrary instructorId-as-value.

findings.issue: getSignedUrlsByStorageIds is public query; only calls requireIdentity() and then signs an arbitrary list of storageIds. The docstring explicitly says it does not verify ownership. Any signed-in caller can obtain signed URLs for any storage blob whose ID they obtain.

findings.issue: migrateMonthlyStorageCost is public mutation with NO auth. Any caller can insert/update billing rows that flow into admin dashboards; the read path (list) is admin-gated.

findings.issue: acceptHdInvitationFromClerk is exported as public action (not internalAction) and accepts webhookSecret as an arg passed on the wire. The action verifies the secret value, but the secret travels through every Convex call stack; if the webhook secret is reused elsewhere, finding it leaks all webhook acceptances. Public-action namespace means anyone can mount a replay-protected-by-secret over the standard Convex client.
findings.fix: Convert to internalAction and have a service-keyed HTTP route accept and forward the (timestamp, signature, body) Svix tuple.

findings.issue: logShareAccess is a public mutation that inserts an hdShareAccess audit row for any signed-in identity, even when the identity is not in the share's audience. Audit pollution — fake 'viewed by X / downloaded by X' rows for shareIds the caller has no relationship with.
findings.fix: Look up the share row and verify the caller's identity is in the audience (creator/owning instructor/admin) before writing the audit row; or move to internalMutation with an audience-aware wrapper.

findings.issue: logViewWorkspaceAudit is public mutation with no auth; takes adminId:string from the caller and writes a row to workspaceAuditLogs for any workspaceId. Audit pollution by signed-in non-admin callers.
findings.fix: Auth-gate as admin (or workspace owner when reading self) and derive adminId from identity rather than from args.

findings.issue: updateOrder is a public mutation that does a .then/.collect() chain at orders.ts:369-372 to find an existing order by id literal — full-table scan for every patch attempt. Also .filter() after withIndex at line 366.

findings.issue: migrateOrder has .filter(q => q.eq status) after withIndex by_userId — full scan of user's orders.
findings.fix: Add a by_userId_status index.

findings.issue: Date.now() in query handler. Convex folds the value at query-start time but reactive subscribers see the same value across the subscription window — breaks anything that watches this surface.
findings.fix: Move to internalQuery (the function is a cron target anyway) or compute at the caller.

findings.issue: Same Date.now() pattern as queries/http.ts:12.

findings.issue: Date.now() / new Date() in query handler.

findings.issue: .filter(q => q.and(eq provider, eq status)) after withIndex on orderId — full scan of orderId's payment rows whenever the filter predicates are not indexable.
findings.fix: Add a dedicated index (by_orderId_provider_status) and remove the .filter().

findings.issue: .filter(q -> q.eq clerkId identity.subject) on users. Single-row lookup so cost is small; textbook .filter() anti-pattern.
findings.fix: Switch to withIndex('by_clerkId').

findings.issue: resolveUploadAccess is exported as public query but the docstring says 'Internal query'. Callers reach it via (internal as any).onboardingWorkExamples.resolveUploadAccess — the export kind is wrong (label-vs-actual mismatch).

findings.issue: Same issue at resolveDownloadAccess — public query export with 'Internal query' docstring.

findings.issue: getNotificationForRecipient is declared internalMutation but it only reads a single document — typo. Should be internalQuery.
